control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: corrective action - material unwanted event control at PSV-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on PSV-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically inspecting embankments and instrumentation. PSV-7104 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 22 December 2024 a corrective action on PSV-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
